title: Verify All Filters Are Working on Agreements Page

steps.text: Navigate to agreements page at https://admin.ztaygo.com/agreements
Check if login input is visible
If login needed: fill email and password fields with test credentials
If login needed: click login button
Wait for page load after login
If login was required: navigate to agreements page again
Wait for agreements page to fully load
Verify search input with placeholder 'Search' is visible
If status filter exists: click status filter combobox
Wait for page load after status filter click
Verify table body rows count is greater than or equal to 0
Fill search input with 'test'
Wait for page load after search input
Verify search results row count is greater than or equal to 0
If date range picker button exists: click the date range button
Wait for page load after date range click
Verify date filtered results row count is greater than or equal to 0
If type filter combobox exists: click the type filter
Wait for page load after type filter click
Verify type filtered results row count is greater than or equal to 0
Verify table element is visible
Verify search input is still visible
